description: `uri` on CreateUserResponse and ResetUserResponse is 'the connection string for the user to the instance' (spec, user.uri), answered next to the `password` member convert already marks. A connection string for a just-issued login can hold its password, so it would print in logs, spans and error causes. The spec's example (`jdbc:sqlserver//user@localhost`) shows no password, and no live response has been read, so this is the cautious direction: nothing changes on the wire, callers just get a Redacted value.
